doc.title: Promptzilla — Adventure
start.intro: Year 2035. Promptzilla, a monster that grows fatter with every lazy prompt, prowls the University. Your mission: beat the challenges without feeding it.
start.rule.move: Click on the scene to move and on characters to talk to them.
start.rule.challenges: Some characters will give you challenges about the course.
start.rule.tokens: In each challenge you can ask the AI, but it costs tokens: Socratic mode costs half as much as direct mode.
start.rule.once: Each challenge can only be answered once. If you get it wrong, you'll see the solution.
start.rule.report: At the end you'll get a report on how you used the AI.
start.privacy.title: Anonymous game log
start.privacy.text: Your interaction with the game is logged anonymously for teaching research. The text of your prompts is not stored, nor any data that could identify you or link the log to you.
start.slow: Still loading, but you can start now.
end.flavor.high: You've fed Promptzilla: it gobbled up almost all your tokens and now prowls the faculty bigger than ever.
end.flavor.low: You've put Promptzilla on a diet: it barely tasted your tokens and is still hungry.
end.flavor.mid: Promptzilla is still in town, but you didn't feed it today. The faculty can breathe.
challenge.exitTitle: Leave the challenge and come back later
challenge.modeHelpDirect: Direct (×2): the AI gives you the full solution. It costs twice as many tokens.
challenge.modeHelpSocratic: Socratic (×1): the AI doesn't give you the solution, only hints and questions so you get there yourself. It costs half.
challenge.placeholder: Type your question and press Ask (or Enter)…
challenge.noTokens: ⛔ No tokens left — answer on your own
challenge.costTooHigh: ⛔ Estimated cost: {cost} tokens — you only have {tokens}
challenge.warnProfanity: ⚠️ Mind your language: rephrase your question without offensive words.
challenge.warnNoTokens: ⚠️ No tokens left. You can't ask the LLM.
challenge.warnTooExpensive: ⚠️ This question costs {cost} tokens and you only have {tokens}. Shorten it or use Socratic mode.
challenge.failed: 📡 The connection failed, AI things… please try again.
report.noConsults: You didn't ask the LLM in any challenge.
report.title: Your prompt report
end.summary.zero: You got none of the {total} challenges right.
end.summary.other: You got {count} of the {total} challenges right.
scene.entrance.name: Faculty hall
scene.entrance.caption: School of Computer Science. Year 2035. It smells of bad coffee and overloaded models.
scene.entrance.poster.look: A faded poster: «WANTED: Promptzilla. Danger level: medium. Reward: 3 ECTS credits». Someone has added in pen: 'saw it yesterday in the cafeteria, it ordered a macchiato'.
scene.classroom.name: Room 0.01
scene.classroom.caption: The final exam room. The holographic blackboard flickers nervously.
scene.classroom.blackboard.look: The blackboard says: «FINAL EXAM — Asking the LLM is forbidden… unless you know how to ask well». The teacher looks at it with suspicious pride.
scene.classroom2.name: Room 0.02
scene.classroom2.caption: Another classroom, this one in daylight. Here the exam is first thing in the morning, no excuses.
scene.classroom2.blackboard.look: The blackboard shows: «Room B — Here you CAN use the AI… if you prove you don't need it». Below, in small print: 'and bring coffee for everyone'.
scene.studyroom.name: Study room
scene.studyroom.caption: Study room. Two classmates pretend to revise while arguing about HTML tags.
scene.studyroom.vending.look: A coffee machine with a sticker: «Powered by AI». It charges in tokens. Of course it charges in tokens.
scene.rooftop.name: Faculty rooftop
scene.rooftop.caption: The rooftop. At sunset, above the city… and there it is, digesting tokens.
scene.rooftop.skyline.look: The city of 2035 flickers with holographic ads. One of them reads: «Responsible AI: ask less, think more». Nobody pays attention.
scene.plaza.name: Faculty entrance
scene.plaza.caption: The entrance square. Drones flying overhead, the city buzzing in the background.
scene.plaza.students-talk.look: A huddle of students whispers about AI. You catch snippets: «...don't dump an essay on the model, every token costs»; «be specific: ask exactly for what you need and that's it»; «I burnt half my balance asking it things in a roundabout way… learn from my mistakes».
scene.plaza.billboard.look: An advertising billboard: «Enrolment 2035: now with AI tutoring included». In small print: 'the AI takes no responsibility for your transcript'.
scene.plaza.scooter.look: A parked e-scooter. It has a sticker: «Unlock with a prompt». Nobody remembers which one.
dlg.hint.lastPractice: By the way, with this one you've done all three practice challenges: the teacher is waiting for you in room 0.01 for the final exam.
dlg.studentGirl.name: Student with a ponytail
dlg.studentGirl.intro: Oh, hi! You're also on the final exam? I've been revising HTML ever since Promptzilla ate the syllabus from the cloud.
dlg.studentGirl.intro.challenge: Can you give me a practice challenge?
dlg.studentGirl.intro.topic: What do you know about Promptzilla?
dlg.studentGirl.spent.failed: You've already seen my challenge, solution included. Now make it stick.
dlg.studentGirl.spent.passed: You nailed my challenge already. I won't give you the same one twice, you'd get bored.
dlg.studentGirl.spent.topic: What do you know about Promptzilla?
dlg.studentGirl.gossip: Promptzilla? It's been in town for years. They say it was born from people asking the AI to 'just do it for me'. Now it even has a verified account.
dlg.studentGirl.gossip.challenge: Give me a challenge, go on.
dlg.studentGirl.wonMore: Boom! You can tell you studied and didn't just copy.
dlg.studentGirl.wonLast: Boom! You can tell you studied and didn't just copy.
dlg.studentGirl.lostMore: Ouch, close. Now you know which one it was: write it down, not even one extra <div> gets forgiven.
dlg.studentGirl.lostLast: Ouch, close. Now you know which one it was: write it down.
dlg.studentBoy.name: Student with headphones
dlg.studentBoy.intro: Hey. *pulls headphones down* I'm revising with lo-fi and good intentions. Want me to quiz you with a practice one?
dlg.studentBoy.spent.failed: *puts one earcup back on* You already burnt my question, bro. But you know the answer now, that's what counts.
dlg.studentBoy.spent.passed: *puts one earcup back on* You already got my question, bro. Nothing more to scrape here.
dlg.studentBoy.meta: Sure, but in Socratic mode. If you ask for the answer spoon-fed, Promptzilla gets fatter and I cringe for you.
dlg.studentBoy.lostMore: Nah, chill. I didn't get it first time either. Keep the answer in mind, there's no second round here.
dlg.studentBoy.lostLast: Nah, chill. I didn't get it first time either. Keep the answer in mind.
dlg.studentGlasses.name: Student with glasses
dlg.studentGlasses.intro: (Looks up from the tablet) Hi. I'm sorting my notes by semantic tags, as one should. Shall I throw you a practice challenge?
dlg.studentGlasses.intro.topic: Notes on a tablet? You don't just use AI?
dlg.studentGlasses.spent.failed: (Without looking up) You already did my challenge and saw the solution. Repeating it would be cheating, and we don't do that here.
dlg.studentGlasses.spent.passed: (Without looking up) You already solved my challenge, and well. Repeating it wouldn't teach you anything new.
dlg.studentGlasses.spent.topic: Notes on a tablet? You don't just use AI?
dlg.studentGlasses.meta: I use AI to understand, not to think for me. Specific prompt, useful answer, and Promptzilla stays on a diet.
dlg.studentGlasses.wonMore: Flawless. That's knowing it inside, not in your chat history.
dlg.studentGlasses.wonLast: Flawless. That's knowing it inside, not in your chat history.
dlg.studentGlasses.lostMore: Close. You have the solution in front of you now: understand it, don't just memorise it.
dlg.studentGlasses.lostLast: Close. You have the solution in front of you now: understand it, don't just memorise it.
dlg.teacher.name: Teacher
dlg.teacher.notReady.leave: All right, I'll go and practise.
dlg.teacher.notReady.insist: Can't you pass me for persistence?
dlg.teacher.insist: Young one, this is 2035, not a business meeting. Here you prove what you know. Go practise.
dlg.teacher.ready: Well, I see you've done all the practice challenges. Good. Last question of the final exam, and there's only one chance. And remember: you can ask the LLM, but every token you waste… you know who gets fatter.
dlg.teacher.passed: Passed! And without feeding the monster. There's hope for this faculty after all.
dlg.teacher.failed: I'm sorry, but it's a fail. And now that you've seen the answer, there's no point repeating it. Review how you used the AI and come back next year.
dlg.teacher.alreadyPassed: You've already passed. Go and celebrate… but pay for the coffee in cash, not in tokens.
dlg.promptzilla.name: Promptzilla
dlg.promptzilla.root: GRRR… *burps a cloud of tokens* Well, a human. Have you come to feed me miles-long prompts or to play the responsible one?
dlg.promptzilla.root.origin: How did you get all the way up here?
dlg.promptzilla.root.threat: I've come to make you leave the faculty alone.
dlg.promptzilla.origin: I was born from a thousand «do the whole assignment for me». Every thoughtless shortcut fattens me up. I'm, let's say, your technical debt… with legs.
dlg.promptzilla.threat: You and how many ECTS credits? Pass the final exam without wasting tokens and maybe I'll slim down. Maybe.
dlg.teacher.notReady.one: The final exam? With that I-slept-three-hours face, no. You still have 1 practice challenge to go. Come back when you can tell a <section> from a <div>.
dlg.teacher.notReady.other: The final exam? With that I-slept-three-hours face, no. You still have {count} practice challenges to go. Come back when you can tell a <section> from a <div>.
